details:
I am writing to request heightened platform-level measures against the influx of automated third-party bot accounts currently plaguing public and group instances.

These bots frequently use automated workflows to target users, log data, and exploit local cache access to rip and illegally redistribute custom 3D avatars. Because manual blocking is an endless cycle—given how quickly banned bots create new replacement accounts—creators need stronger backend defenses.

To help combat this, I would like to request that VRChat consider implementing:

 * Heuristic Detection for Scraping Bots: Enhanced automated detection to identify and flag accounts exhibiting rapid, non-human behavioral patterns typical of automated logging and asset-scraping tools.

 * Stricter Upload & Verification Controls: Additional friction or signature requirements for new or unverified accounts attempting to rapidly publish multiple imported avatar packages.

 * Proactive Public Instance Security: Expanded platform safeguards to curb mass-harvesting in public worlds, protecting creators who share their work publicly.

Protecting the community from automated theft is vital to maintaining a safe environment for developers and artists on the platform. Thank you for your ongoing work on VRChat's security systems and for considering this feedback.

Best regards,

BeeBootheMayu
title: Subject: Feature Request: Mitigation for Automated Bot Accounts and Mass Avatar Ripping
